LanguageData.LP_LS_TinyHut.label: tiny hut dome
LanguageData.LP_LS_TinyHut.description: A force dome of radius 3 raised by the lake seal "Tiny hut": projectiles fired from outside can't get in, and those inside stay at a constant temperature. Vanishes when the caster leaves the dome or after 8 hours.
LanguageData.LP_ClearLakeCrystal.label: clarity crystal
LanguageData.LP_ClearLakeCrystal.description: A Mana Lake clarity crystal. Using it opens a window to choose a learned lake seal to erase (no refund), freeing up the slot.
